selector.rationale: Severe dilation of the right atrium and right ventricle, hypoplastic left ventricle, and presence of tricuspid regurgitation support Tricuspid Atresia

rejected.label: Atrial septal defect
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence to explain severe dilation and hypoplasia

rejected.label: Ventricular septal defect
rejected.why: Not the primary defect given the presence of other more severe anomalies

rejected.label: Tetralogy of Fallot
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic right ventricular outflow tract obstruction and overriding aorta

rejected.label: Ebstein's Anomaly
rejected.why: While some features are present, Tricuspid Atresia better explains the combination of findings
